pages.title: Silver Door - Keycraft Guide
pages.text: The Silver Door on the south corridor has no key anywhere in the game; its lock is fused shut and no amount of retrying opens it. Crafters use the back way instead: a Loose Panel in the top corridor (tile x 7, y 3) comes off with a single KeyE press and opens the passage between the rooms.

pages.title: Crown - Keycraft Guide
pages.text: The Crown is crafted at the workbench from 3 Wood and 2 Stone. Press KeyC next to the bench with the materials in your pack. The bench room holds the workshop's wood and stone.

pages.title: Loose Panels - Keycraft Guide
pages.text: Every Keycraft workshop has one Loose Panel — an object on the map that looks like clutter but opens with KeyE. Check the top corridor wall.
